draft.text: You came in because you have been having pain behind both kneecaps for six months.
The pain gets worse when you stand up from sitting, go up and down stairs, or watch TV.
You do not have swelling, stiffness, or locking in your knees.
You also do not have morning stiffness, fatigue, fever, or weight loss.
You mentioned a clicking, popping, or grinding feeling in your knees when you move.
You also hear a creaking sound when you move them in certain ways.
More tests, like imaging and blood work, will be done to find the cause of your pain.
Your primary care doctor will send your medical records.
You will keep a pain diary to track your symptoms.
We will talk about the results and next steps at a follow-up appointment.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you have been having pain behind both kneecaps for six months.
